_note: What an expedition can pack (spec §12). Game items do what the game says they do (class mechanic: Potions heal outside battle, an Escape Rope takes you to a cave's entrance, Repel keeps weaker wild Pokémon away); camp gear is Blackthorn's (class creative). `covers` lists the capabilities an item meets on its own; `for` names the layer C rule (capability/model.json) it equips a Pokémon for. `gear` links the equipment library (equipment/gear.py) where the item is one of the games' own.

items.name: Potions and Full Heals
items.what: restore HP and cure status outside battle
items.limitations: only as many as you carry

items.name: Escape Rope
items.what: takes you back to a cave's entrance

items.name: Repel
items.what: weaker wild Pokémon stay away for a set number of steps
items.limitations: only Pokémon weaker than your lead

items.name: Fishing rods
items.what: Pokémon (and food) from the water

items.name: Itemfinder or Dowsing Machine
items.what: finds hidden items

items.name: A map (Town Map, Pokégear, PokéNav)
items.what: where you are and the way on

items.name: Go-Goggles
items.what: lets you through a sandstorm (Emerald's desert)

items.name: Bicycle
items.what: faster travel on roads

items.name: Tent and bedrolls
items.what: shelter from rain and wind

items.name: Camp stove and fuel
items.what: cooking and a little warmth

items.name: Lanterns
items.what: light in caves and at night

items.name: Water filter
items.what: safe water from streams and snowmelt
items.limitations: needs a water source to filter

items.name: Rations
items.what: food for the days packed
items.limitations: only the days you packed for

items.name: Cold-weather clothing and sleeping bags
items.what: keeps the trainer warm

items.name: Shade, wide hats and light clothing
items.what: keeps the trainer cool

items.name: Rope, harness and ice axe
items.what: the trainer's own climbing gear
items.limitations: slow; no substitute for a Pokémon that climbs

items.name: First-aid kit
items.what: for people: cuts, sprains, cold

items.name: Pack harness and sled
items.what: lets a large, strong Pokémon pull a load
items.limitations: the Pokémon has to be used to it

items.name: Saddle
items.what: lets a large Pokémon carry a rider
items.limitations: the Pokémon has to be used to it

items.name: Tool kit
items.what: hand tools a Pokémon with a grip can use
items.limitations: the Pokémon has to be taught

items.name: Garden tools
items.what: tools for tending crops
items.limitations: the Pokémon has to be taught

items.name: Rescue kit
items.what: harness, lines and a stretcher for search and rescue
items.limitations: the Pokémon has to be trained

items.name: Dynamo and storage battery
items.what: turns an Electric type's charge into stored power and lamps
items.limitations: output depends on the Pokémon resting
